description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_Lexer class, which provides functionality for lexing (tokenizing) HTML/SGML markup into tokens, with methods for parsing entities, normalizing HTML, and handling CDATA sections. It also includes a factory method for creating lexer instances based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer
classes.description: A forgiving lexer for SGML-style markup, capable of tokenizing HTML into tokens, parsing entities, and normalizing HTML content. It serves as a base class with factory method for creating specific lexer implementations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate and return a specific lexer implementation based on configuration or environment detection.

methods.name: parseData
methods.description: Parses special HTML entities in a string into their corresponding characters.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Abstract method intended to lex an HTML string into tokens; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: escapeCDATA
methods.description: Converts CDATA sections into escaped form.

methods.name: escapeCommentedCDATA
methods.description: Converts convoluted CDATA sections within comments into escaped form.

methods.name: CDATACallback
methods.description: Callback used during CDATA escaping to convert CDATA content into HTML entities.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Normalizes HTML content by converting newlines, escaping CDATA, extracting body, expanding entities, and cleaning UTF-8.

methods.name: extractBody
methods.description: Extracts the content within the <body> tag from HTML, or returns the original if no body tag is found.
